the Taylor story i tell everyone: an NFL tight end beaded his number onto a bracelet, meant to slip it to her at a Kansas City Eras night, and lost his nerve. then he admitted it on air — and that flustered confession is where End Game starts:

why: X sibling of the 09-26 End Game thread hero. Hook: the artifact (calendar's assigned X hook) — opens on the bracelet with his number, written as its own post in fully distinct wording from the IG (rewritten once after check-drafts flagged 83% cross-post similarity on the first pass; now well under the 80% gate). Same story-unique campaign + scheduledAt as the IG. Facts sourced identically (relationships.mjs rel-kelce + the item card in the IG's slide-2 screenshot): the bracelet with his number, made for a Kansas City / Arrowhead Eras Tour stop, never delivered; his 2023 New Heights podcast admission. Kelce is an NFL tight end (Kansas City Chiefs; Arrowhead is in Kansas City) — accurate, not embellished. Confirmed public relationship history; no wedding angle. NOTE ON MEDIA: this X carries a photo ONLY because check-drafts.mjs hard-requires X media (lines 577-579, 2026-09-10) — text-only X, which the calendar planned and L001's escape hatch prefers here, is checker-blocked (the standing #3733 conflict, surfaced again in the PR body). Decorative tour tile, not the argument — hence mediaEarnsItsPlace 3. photoEra unset (cross-era thread, not a themed family; no era-relevance claim on the photo).
